title: Independent root strings have endpoint sum at most three
statement: Let $I$ be finite, let $V,W$ be vector spaces over $\mathbf Q$ [def-weil-field], and let $P:\mathrm{RootPairing}\ I\ \mathbf Q\ V\ W$ be a reduced crystallographic root pairing: injective root and coroot families in a perfect bilinear pairing, root-coroot value $2$, simultaneous reflection permutations, integral root-coroot pairings, and no proportional roots except a root and its negative. Let $i,j\in I$ have linearly independent roots. Write $p=P.\mathrm{chainBotCoeff}(i,j)$ and $q=P.\mathrm{chainTopCoeff}(i,j)$ for the largest nonnegative integers such that $P.\mathrm{root}(j)-pP.\mathrm{root}(i)$ and $P.\mathrm{root}(j)+qP.\mathrm{root}(i)$ are roots. Then $p+q\le3$.
